description: duplicate with `parent` (O11 lane, reactive). (1) An IContainer keeps its children in the placeholder `content`, not in itself: with `parent` = another IContainer the copy goes into its `content` (the native container inside the parent that accepts the type). (2) The OnException is the ONLY one of a UI flow: the copy goes to another UI flow with `parent`. Each `get` only resolves if the copy ended up at the destination.

expectedMessages.why: the original OnException handles All Exceptions in the MainFlow (the warning is from the original, not from the copy); it is the simplest handler that the Verify accepts

ops._why: parent is the IContainer; the paste goes to its content placeholder
proves the destination: the only IContainer inside DupBoxInto is the copy
the MainFlow already has its OnException; the other flow does not yet
